title: The Broken Wall
html:
This quest is not fully written yet. Steps, items or dialogue may be missing.Miner Tobb has looked at the wall the kobolds dug through into Silverdelve, and he thinks they meant to find the mine.

About

Given byMiner Tobb
Level22
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points1

What you need

  • Kobold Tunnel Charm ×3

Steps

  1. Talk to Miner Tobb (outdoors around -314, -1053) to get the quest.
  2. Kobold shamans in the lower drift (4)
    Kobold tunnel charms (3) - Kobold Tunnel Charm at -314, -1053
  3. Report to Thane Hallvard inside Frostspire

Rewards

Reward
Gold1,280
Character XP40,000
Quest points1

What Miner Tobb says

Miner Tobb: Bone and twine. This one still has grit on it from the far side of the wall.

Miner Tobb: Go and tell the thane what you saw down there. I'll stay with the mine.

You: Tobb says the kobolds dug into Silverdelve on purpose.

Thane Hallvard: On purpose. Kobolds move into mines we've left empty. Digging into one full of dwarves is something new.

Thane Hallvard: So something on the far side of the mountain is pushing them. I need to think on this, and I'll need you again before long. Rest while you can.

Handing it in

"So something on the far side of the mountain is pushing them. I need to think on this, and I'll need you again before long. Rest while you can."
